dict.string: Anticipy connects to your pendant over Bluetooth. The pendant does not transcribe yet — its audio used to be sent to a transcription company, and that was removed because raw audio should never leave your devices. Only needed if you have a pendant.

Anticipy reads what is coming up in the next month — the title and the time, nothing else — so she knows what you already have on. She never reads the notes or the invitees, and never puts anything in your calendar unless you ask her to.

Anticipy reads what is coming up in the next month — the title and the time, nothing else — so she knows what you already have on. She never reads the notes or the invitees, and never puts anything in your calendar unless you ask her to.
Anticipy reads the names in your contacts so she knows who you mean when you say one. She never reads a number, an email or an address, and never messages anyone on her own.
Anticipy uses Face ID only to unlock developer diagnostics on this iPhone.

Anticipy listens through your microphone, including in the background, only while listening is on. Supported iPhones recognize speech on-device; otherwise iOS may use Apple's speech service. The resulting text is sent to Anticipy's server so she can act on it.

Anticipy uses iPhone speech recognition to turn audio into text. Supported iPhones do this on-device; otherwise iOS may send audio to Apple's speech service. Anticipy sends the resulting text to her server so she can remember it and act on it.
